request.utterance: SUE-570 파일럿: 같은 글을 실무자용 분석 글로 재구성해줘. 원문의 counterarguments를 정면으로 다루고, 메커니즘과 근거를 밀도 있게 보여줘. suengj.com 편집 레인 초안.

transformation.basis: utterance asks the argument to be rebuilt with a new structure (mechanism decomposition, explicit mapping table, counterargument-by-counterargument engagement) rather than merely reworded — recreate, not rewrite; per recreate.json must_preserve, the underlying claims (c1/c2/c3) and their stated uncertainty are carried forward unchanged.

content_type.basis: utterance asks for an evidence-first analysis answering a stated question, matching research.json's intent; its required_frame_fields (thesis, source_weighting, verification_needs, uncertainty) and its explicit demand to confront counterargument/boundary evidence fit research.json's evidence_burden.min_source_roles including 'contradicting' directly.

audience.basis: utterance says "실무자용" (for practitioners) directly naming the audience; high jargon_tolerance is used to keep the source's own technical vocabulary (span of control, shadow IT, Goal/Task/Context/Tool/Permission/Evaluation/Agent) unglossed.

surface.basis: utterance says "suengj.com 편집 레인" naming the publication surface directly.

artifacts.basis: utterance asks for a written analysis; text/article is the planned text-artifact id in editorial/profiles/axes.json.

the research register's higher information density and explicit engagement with the source's counterarguments call for a multi-module synthesis (mechanism, authority shift, the flat-vs-centralized interpretation, and the understand-vs-delegate tension) — matches body-infographic's 'high semantic density, low visual density, 2-4 modules, one reading path' target directly, unlike the single-relationship explanatory-diagram used for the news variant.

sources.note: The canonical, already-published (status: published) source. Not modified by this pilot. answer.claims (c1, c2, c3, kind: interpretation) is the factual-integrity baseline; counterarguments front matter block is treated as real material to engage, per the task brief.
